newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-PADRES ACTIVATE CF FINLEY FROM DISABLED LIST.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-PADRES ACTIVATE CF FINLEY FROM DISABLED LIST.

text.p: The struggling San Diego Padres regained the services of centerfielder Steve Finley, who was activated off the 15-day disabled list on Tuesday.
Finley, who was was suffering from left elbow soreness, had not played since April 19 and was placed on the disabled list April 25.
In his absence, the Padres dropped 11 of their last 13 games, including a eight-game losing streak, to fall to last place in the National League West after winning the division title last season.
Finley, who was moved to the third spot in the batting order at the start of the season, is hitting .220 (9-for-41) with a team-leading six doubles and nine RBI in 12 games.
He enjoyed a career-best season for the Padres in 1996 with 30 homers, 95 RBI and a .298 batting average.

Finley's return will be most welcome with Rickey Henderson, who saw increased playing time in Finley's absence, hitting just .164, while starting left fielder Greg Vaughn is struggling with a .183 batting average.
